name: claude-skill-concise
description: Response-style skills: the answer first, nothing padding it, and no sacrifice in correctness.

plugins.name: concise
plugins.description: English. The answer goes in the first sentence; cut preamble and process narration; keep every caveat that changes what the reader does. Ships an always-on SessionStart hook with self-update, a credit guard on the commands that publish text, the rewrite/pr/card/commit commands, and an audit agent.

plugins.name: respostas-curtas
plugins.description: Português (BR). A resposta vem na primeira frase; corte preâmbulo e narração de processo; nunca corte o que muda uma decisão. Embarca um hook SessionStart sempre ligado com auto-update, guarda de crédito nos comandos que publicam texto, os comandos reescrever/pr/card/commit, e um agente de auditoria.
